places-abrigo-de-los-sabinares-o-ventana.story: 245 km from Nerpio to Nerpio, about 4 h 13 of riding. On the way it passes Gabar, Cueva de las Palamas and back through Gabar. The highest point is about 1,400 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Middlesex Fells and the Mystic Lakes
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 11 km this is Middlesex Fells and the Mystic Lakes, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

facts.v: Middlesex Fells and the Mystic Lakes

middlesex-fells-and-the-mystic-lakes.story: A 34 km round trip from Medford by way of Arlington - roughly 39 min in the saddle. The stops in between: Middlesex Fells and Winchester. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
